## Decisions

- [API keys stay in the environment](memory/decisions/api-keys-stay-in-the-environment.md) — config.yaml names the variable that holds a key; a pasted key is rejected at load.
- [Assistant-driven bootstrap needs no LLM](memory/decisions/assistant-driven-bootstrap-needs-no-llm.md) — With no memory and no LLM, Memdex seeds a template the user's own coding assistant fills.
- [Failures degrade rather than abort](memory/decisions/failures-degrade-rather-than-abort.md) — The markdown files are the product; the vectors are an index over them, and an index can always be rebuilt.
- [Managed sources beat readonly ones](memory/decisions/managed-sources-beat-readonly-ones.md) — When the same memory appears in both a managed source and a readonly one, the managed copy wins and the readonly twin…
- [Python instead of Go](memory/decisions/python-instead-of-go.md) — The original specification asked for Go and for a local ChromaDB.
- [Stable IDs through an adoption ladder](memory/decisions/stable-ids-through-an-adoption-ladder.md) — Identity is adopted through a ladder of increasingly weak signals rather than derived from the file path, so an…
- [Two token numbers, not one](memory/decisions/two-token-numbers-not-one.md) — Memdex reports context cost and content size separately, because they measure different things and conflating them…

## Conventions

- [Compression must never change meaning](memory/conventions/compression-must-never-change-meaning.md) — This is the rule the whole optimizer is built around.
- [Discovery is never a repository sweep](memory/conventions/discovery-is-never-a-repository-sweep.md) — Only configured locations are read.
- [Never pass query_texts to Chroma](memory/conventions/never-pass-query-texts-to-chroma.md) — Every call passes explicit embeddings= or query_embeddings=.
- [Readonly sources are never written to](memory/conventions/readonly-sources-are-never-written-to.md) — layout.diff_ops asserts that every planned file operation lands under a managed source or one of the output paths.
- [Errors carry a hint](memory/conventions/errors-carry-a-hint.md) — Every user-facing error has a message and a hint saying what to do next.
- [Re-running is a no-op by construction](memory/conventions/re-running-is-a-no-op-by-construction.md) — Generated files carry no timestamps — times live in the registry and backup manifests instead.
